description: Valid cases carry a complete value. Invalid cases name a valid base case of the same section; replace the top-level keys listed in patch, then remove the top-level keys listed in omit. Every invalid case breaks exactly one rule of its section.

listRequests.description: Request of get_remote_agent_thread_requests. serverId is 1 to serverIdBytes characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore and hyphen, starting with a letter or digit. runnerId is 1 to runnerIdBytes UTF-8 bytes without control characters. threadId and every turnId are runner UUIDs: lowercase, version 4. turns holds at most turnsPerRequest entries with distinct turnIds and may be empty. startedAtEpochMs is a safe integer of at least 0. interactionSequence is null or a safe integer of at least 0. cursor is null or 1 to cursorChars characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore, period, colon and hyphen. No other key is accepted at any level.

listResponses.description: Response of get_remote_agent_thread_requests. respondRequests.description: Request of respond_remote_agent_thread_request. serverId, runnerId and threadId follow the rules of the list request; turn is one turn descriptor of the list request. requestId is a runner UUID like threadId, because the runner answers a question or an approval only under its UUID. Every questionId and optionId is 1 to idBytes characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore, period, colon and hyphen, starting with a letter or digit. A question response holds 1 to answersPerResponse answers with distinct questionIds; an answer holds at most optionIdsPerAnswer distinct optionIds and at most answerTextBytes UTF-8 bytes of text, and has an option or text that is not blank. An approval response holds one of decisions. No other key is accepted at any level.
